svg.aria-label: Stop 04 of 11 on the map, 论剑台 (Sword-Discussion Arena): Hackathons. 36 hackathons won out of 59 entered (61%). One sword for each hackathon, gold for a win. “Just cause you lost at a hackathon doesn’t mean it’s a bad project.” Me, in an interview, September 2026.
